title: Eating out
intro: From getting a table to paying the bill. Many of these lines also work at a café, a snack bar or the canteen at the sports club.

notes.title: graag: the easy way to be polite
body: Put graag after what you want, or use “Ik wil graag …”. It works like “please” and “I'd like” at the same time.

notes.title: Spa rood and spa blauw
body: Spa is a brand of mineral water, but people use it for any bottled water. Spa rood is sparkling and spa blauw is still. Tap water is kraanwater.

examples.en: Can I have a glass of tap water?

cards.en: What would you like to drink?

reply.nl: Een spa rood en een appelsap, graag.
reply.en: A sparkling water and an apple juice, please.

cards.en: Do you have a kids' menu?

reply.en: Yes, on the back of the menu.

cards.nl: Ze wil graag patat met appelmoes.
cards.en: She'd like fries with apple sauce.

cards.nl: Mag ik nog een glas water?
cards.en: Could I have another glass of water?
Would you like anything else to drink?

cards.nl: Voor hier of om mee te nemen?
cards.en: For here or to take away?
